buildCommand: if [ "$VERCEL_ENV" != "production" ]; then H="${VERCEL_BRANCH_URL:-$VERCEL_URL}"; if [ -n "$H" ]; then sed -i "s#https://fundedmentor.com/brand/og-image.jpg#https://$H/brand/og-image.jpg#g; s#property=\"og:url\" content=\"https://fundedmentor.com/\"#property=\"og:url\" content=\"https://$H/\"#" index.html; echo "OG tags now point to https://$H"; fi; fi
